title: Phone: in German the avatar menu is wider than the screen and pushes the language submenu off it
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found while building #35425 (PR #36040; screenshots in that PR's evidence). Under epic #34571.

## What happens

At 375 wide with the interface in German, the avatar menu is wider than the screen because the German row labels are long, and the language submenu opens partly off screen. English and Chinese fit. PR #36040 does not touch the avatar menu's content, so this is there on main too.

## To do

1. Keep the avatar menu and its submenus inside the viewport at phone width in every shipped language: cap the menu width to the viewport and let long labels wrap or truncate with the full text available.
2. On phone, open the language submenu where it fits (below, or as its own sheet) instead of to the side.
3. Pin it with a 375-wide check in German (and one more long-label language).

## Acceptance

- At 375 wide in all eleven interface languages, the avatar menu and the language list are fully on screen and every language can be picked.
